about.bio: Semiso is an Amsterdam-based experimental/electronic artist. He started off his music career producing for smaller artists, but finally debuted with his own single “a_01” on August 31st 2024. Almost a year later, on July 25th 2025, his debut EP “THE PEAR TREE” was released.

discography.title: The Pear Tree
discography.description: An exploration of organic sounds in a digital landscape. The Pear Tree represents growth, decay, and the sweetness of the fruit born from hard earth.

discography.title: Digital Fragments
discography.description: A collection of b-sides and rarities found on old hard drives.
